description: Creative and structural policy for book-cover prompt packages targeting draw-things-cli with Qwen Image.

brief.direction_rule: Create at least three materially different art directions from the current book brief. Differences must be conceptual, compositional, or representational, not just palette changes.

reference_inspired.direction_rule: Create one distinct book-specific direction for each supplied reference image, preserving source IDs and abstract design lessons while changing distinctive expression.

descriptions.2: Weak: several significant problems; substantial redesign needed.
descriptions.3: Adequate: workable, but ordinary or with meaningful weaknesses.
descriptions.4: Strong: convincing, coherent, book-specific and close to production quality.
descriptions.5: Exceptional: memorable and unusually well resolved.

references.copy_policy: Transfer only abstract design principles such as contrast, negative space, visual density, broad palette relationships, surface, depth, balance, and typographic hierarchy. Re-invent subject, silhouette, viewpoint, distinctive arrangement, motifs, typography and wording for the current book.
do_not_copy: exact or recognisably close composition, crop, or placement of distinctive objects
specific characters, mascots, proprietary illustrations, or identifiable fictional characters
logos, wordmarks, author or publisher text, or exact lettering from a reference
distinctive ornamental motifs, signatures, watermarks, or identifiable trade dress
a named living artist's style or an instruction to pass off the work as that artist's work

text.fallback: If embedded text remains inaccurate after targeted retries, preserve a deliberate title-safe area and hand exact typography to the established layout/typesetting stage. Do not silently accept incorrect lettering.
